esp32.detail: 5 pins wired; Added a 10 kΩ pull-up resistor from SDA to 3V3, as the datasheet requires. Added a 10 kΩ pull-up resistor from SCL to 3V3, as the datasheet requires. It shares the I2C bus (SDA D21, SCL D22) at address 0x5d. Added the sfa30.py driver written from the datasheet.
Reports the formaldehyde, humidity and temperature set on the sliders: passes

Reports the formaldehyde, humidity and temperature set on the sliders: passes
